shorts.label: Hide Shorts
shorts.detail: Removes the Shorts entry, Shorts shelves and Shorts results everywhere.

homefeed.label: Hide Home feed
homefeed.detail: Home opens your Subscriptions instead of recommendations.

related.label: Hide related videos
related.detail: Removes the 'Up next' list beside a video. Playlists still show.

comments.label: Hide comments
comments.detail: Removes the comments section under a video.

ads.label: Hide ads
ads.detail: Hides promoted videos in feeds and search, and skips video ads as soon as the player allows.

foryou.label: Following only
foryou.detail: Home opens on the Following tab. The For You tab is hidden.

trending.label: Hide trends, news & Who to follow
trending.detail: Clears the right-hand column and the Explore page down to search.

extras.label: Hide Grok, Communities & Premium
extras.detail: Removes the Grok, Communities, Premium, Jobs and Verified Orgs entries and the Premium upsell.

homefeed.label: Hide Home & Popular feeds
homefeed.detail: The front page shows nothing to scroll. Communities you open directly still show their posts.

ads.label: Hide ads
ads.detail: Removes promoted posts from every feed and comment page.

recommended.label: Hide Popular Communities & Explore
recommended.detail: Removes suggested communities, Explore, Reddit Answers and trending searches.

allow.note: A single reel opened from a DM or profile stays watchable

reels.label: Hide Reels
reels.detail: Removes the Reels tab and the Reels feed. A reel someone sends you still plays.

explore.label: Hide the Explore grid
explore.detail: Search stays. The grid of suggested posts under it is hidden.

suggested.label: Hide suggested posts & ads
suggested.detail: Removes 'Suggested for you' and sponsored posts from your feed, and the suggested accounts beside it.

live.label: Hide Live
live.detail: Removes the Live tab and live badges.

shop.label: Hide Shop
shop.detail: Removes shopping tabs and shop links.

ai.label: Hide AI-labelled posts
ai.detail: Removes posts Instagram marks as made or edited with AI. Off by default; Instagram only labels some of them.

reposts.label: Hide reposts
reposts.detail: Removes posts that someone you follow reposted rather than made. Off by default.

homefeed.label: Hide Home feed
homefeed.detail: Home keeps the post box and your sidebar. The feed below it is hidden.

pymk.label: Hide People you may know
pymk.detail: Removes suggested connections and follow prompts.

news.label: Hide news & games
news.detail: Removes LinkedIn News and the puzzle games beside the feed, and news cards in Notifications.

ads.label: Hide ads & suggested posts
ads.detail: Removes sponsored content and posts LinkedIn suggests from people you don't follow.

allow.note: A single reel someone sent you stays watchable

homefeed.label: Hide News Feed
homefeed.detail: Home keeps the post box and stories, with nothing to scroll. Groups, Marketplace, messages, events and profiles still work.

reels.label: Hide Reels
reels.detail: Removes the Reels tab. A reel someone sends you still plays.
